messages:
lina: Quick heads-up  Open thread: Clymware reached out to onboard CW-6B into our cloud marketplace and ship a Nimbus Systems SI bundle. Theyre asking for a co-announcement early July and want us to distribute a vendor-optimized artifact.

omar: Technical Qs: will they provide HF + tokenizers? They said fp16 + optional 8-bit. Do we have permission to publish a 4-bit quantized variant under our distro rules?

tess: Licensing note: they propose ASF-2.0 with a separate commercial addendum. That addendum must explicitly permit derivative artifacts (quantization, containerization) and redistribution in our marketplace. Were requesting a signed redistribution amendment and an export/compliance attestation.

ryan: Marketplace requirements from ops side: provenance blurb, dataset attributions, export-control flag, and an embargo field for listing. We should add a checkbox for "dataset usage restrictions" if addendum limits certain datasets.

jules: From marketing: we want logos, a partner quote, and a joint blog. Prefer co-authored PR and a 48h embargo window after sign-off. Need to know the target announce audience (developers, enterprise).

market-bot: Partnership doc created: https://docs.internal.redwood/partnerships/clymware-cw6b (edit access: lina, omar, tess, ryan, jules)

lina: Proposed minimal SI deliverables (compact list):
```
- HF model artifacts (model card + tokenizer.json)
- fp16 weights + optional 8-bit weights
- quantized 4-bit variant (if permitted) + checksum
- certified Docker image (Redwood runtime)
- perf report (latency @seq128 p50/p95, throughput @batch32)
- eval prompts + regression thresholds
- signed redistribution amendment + export attestation
```

omar: I can run the perf pipeline once we have weights + Nimbus hardware spec. Estimate ~4 business days for full perf + kernel tuning. If they want 8-bit kernel validation add ~2 days. Also confirm preferred ONNX vs native PyTorch (we prefer HF native).

tess: Legal asks: 1) Signed redistribution amendment that covers transformations (quantize, strip attention caches) 2) Export compliance attestation (EAR/UK compliance) 3) Short attribution clause for marketplace (one-liner + linkback). Also check indemnity language in the addendum.

ryan: Operational mitigations: 1) add region toggles on listing for export blocks 2) prepare a soft announce date and lock only after legal sign-off 3) queue Nimbus test reservations to avoid validation delays.

jules: I'll draft the joint blog outline: TLDR, partner quote, what Redwood brings (serving optimizations + cost), and a short SI integration case study. Will share a first draft by Tue. Also will prepare social snippets and a technical highlight card.

lina: Risks called out: vendor addendum could require redlines (delay), export controls might restrict some regions, Nimbus validation windows could push timeline. Owners: tess -> legal, omar -> eng perf, ryan -> ops scheduling, jules -> comms.

tess: Action: I'll request the vendor sign the redistribution amendment template and the EAR attestation. Lina, can you confirm the preferred embargo window with the partner?

lina: Will confirm with Clymware today and ask them to upload HF artifacts + provenance checklist to the partnership doc. Also request Nimbus contact for integration testing.

omar: Posting a quick checklist for the vendor in the doc: hardware spec, sample inference script, target batch/seq, and the data used for any fine-tuning.

jules: :thumbsup: Once legal confirms, I'll coordinate PR ops calendar and set the embargo.

market-bot: Ticket PRT-4899 updated: status=vendor_pending
